purpose: Reconciles accessory identities across TP Medal Shop, Shenron wishes, and related special acquisition routes without treating historical shop rotations as permanent availability.

verification_policy.partially_verified: Identity and historical route are supported, but current rotation or exact availability remains time-sensitive.
verification_policy.route_conflict: Sources disagree on acquisition route or the route is version-dependent; preserve both claims until reconciled.
verification_policy.unresolved: A route is reported but cannot safely be attached to an existing canonical identity yet.

source_notes: Historical TP Medal Shop listings show a rotating inventory rather than a permanent all-items-at-once catalog.
Bandai Namco confirms TP Medals remained earnable and usable after TP Medal sales ended in 2024; later STP currency is a separate system.
Shenron wishes are acquisition routes and should not create duplicate accessory identities.
Exact current shop availability is intentionally not inferred from historical listings.
